officialFrom: Names, descriptions and grades exactly as the kit's starter list (Exophase and PSNProfiles, frozen 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
In short: Pops when the other 54 are done: all offline, one playthrough, about 200 hours.
1. All 54 other trophies are offline single-player; the list has no online, multiplayer or DLC trophy. [1][30][60][67]
2. One playthrough is enough: there are no difficulty trophies and no mission medals. [1][58][67][104]
3. No mission replay and no New Game+: keep a manual save at each chapter start. You get 15 manual slots plus one autosave. [1][60][80][87][112]
4. Cheats unlock only after the story (Progress menu); entering one turns trophies off for the session, so keep a clean save. [58][92][94][111]
5. Order: story with optional missions (60-80 h), then the 100% checklist and 70 of 80 challenges (~100 h), then strangers and leftovers. [1][28][58]
6. Difficulty is about 4/10; no trophy is hard on its own. Most of the time goes into the 100% checklist behind A Long Road (gold). [1][30][58][67]
7. The list is 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze; 28 trophies are hidden, every story trophy among them. [1][30][67]

missable.why: It needs Positive Mental Attitude, whose Chapter 1 balcony meditation may count and cannot be redone.

b.text: 250 hours or more, perhaps past 300.

disputes.call: Plan on ~200 h; the longer figure assumes a slower 100% clean-up.

a.text: A cheat turns off trophies and saving for the rest of the session.

b.text: Only trophies are blocked; saving still works (judged from GTA V and RDR2).

disputes.call: Never save with a cheat on; reload a clean save.

b.text: Possibly one: Positive Mental Attitude, via a Chapter 1 meditation.

disputes.call: Treat Positive Mental Attitude as missable.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
In short: Finish Gone Fishing, the first mission after the Prologue. Cannot be missed.
1. The Prologue is played as Lucia; Gone Fishing follows it as the first Jason mission. [96][99][117]
2. Cal gives the mission: you fish drug packages out of the sea. [29][128][131]
3. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
4. Free roam opens after it, so map fog and early activities can start now. [86]
5. Gear Up is next; GTA Wiki says Just a Scratch, Lab Fees and Unwanted Attention open at the same time. [29][131][133]
6. Finishing it unlocks Jason's house in Key Lento, your first safehouse. [29][130][131][132]
7. On the way to the sea plane, a red and white trailer holds optional cash that raises Professional reputation; skip it and it is gone. [29][128][131]
8. Donnie is tied up in a shack by the big turbine at the Kingfishers' camp; crouch and use takedowns, as the camp is too crowded for a gunfight. [29][128][129][131]
9. Ease off the throttle as you reach each dropped package so Cal has time to hook it; there are three to collect. [129][130][131][132]

a.text: It counts as mission 1 of Chapter 1.

b.text: GTABase lists the Prologue on its own.

disputes.call: Either way Gone Fishing comes straight after it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
In short: Finish Chapter 1. Starting Tourist Trap is the point of no return: meditate with Lucia and save first.
1. Chapter 1 is mostly Jason: 22 missions counting the Prologue, through Island Dreams, Feng Shui and Down to Earth to Discharge Time. [97][99][117]
2. Starting Tourist Trap (Kat calls after Recalibration) locks you in: Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time follow with no free roam. [68][101]
3. Before it: accept Lucia's balcony meditation, finish Shirley's two errands and make a manual save. [21][48][49][68][116][121]
4. Jason's cash stash, his Ganado and the Ultimate Edition vehicles do not carry over; only BuckMe savings do. [68][101]
5. The trophy pops after What's in the Bag?, the first Chapter 2 mission. [1][30]
6. In Tourist Trap Jason is shot and you play Lucia with only base health and Focus; keep Jason alive on the way to the boat or the mission fails. [135][136]
7. Kenton's treasure dives, Cal's fishing and the Kingfisher hideouts are not lost: they come back later in the story. [68][135]
8. Jason's Key Lento house is lost for good too; GTABase advises putting at least $5,000 into BuckMe Family Savings before Tourist Trap. [135]
9. Tourist Trap starts when you talk to Lucia on the beach in south Key Lento; nothing forces you to start it, so finish Chapter 1 business first. [101][135]

a.text: GameTrek's trophy page files it under Chapter 2.

b.text: Its own roadmap and the other guides say Chapter 1.

disputes.call: Chapter 1, as the official text says; it pops as Chapter 2 opens.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
In short: Finish Lucia's Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn. Grab the two Starlet Motel cards before it ends.
1. Chapter 2 is Lucia's, around Port Gellhorn, from What's in the Bag? to Checking Out; Jason rejoins for the last missions. [97][99][117]
2. Prepare for Vice City asks for at least $15,000 before the story moves on. [31][137][138]
3. Before Checking Out, take Vicki (motel office bathroom) and Victor Maravilla (kitchen fridge) at the Starlet Motel: both rooms close after Chapter 2. [5][6][95]
4. The trophy pops after Welcome to Vice City, the first Chapter 3 mission. [1][30]
5. Bug: dying in the bike chase can drop Jason as an objective and leave a police search you cannot escape. Restart the mission if it happens. [139][140]
6. Starting Checking Out ends Chapter 2 and you lose the Starlet Motel as a home for good, so finish anything there first. [139][140]
7. Checking Out starts after a call about an article Cal sent: go back to the motel room and use the bathroom door. [139][140]
8. Deposit cash into BuckMe as you earn it, so a death does not cost you part of the $15,000. [137][138]
9. Good money for the $15,000: Billy's two jobs, Hit Avery Pawn, Hit Kingpin Bowling, Impounded Vehicle, Veteran Hunted (Jason) and Afternoon Delight. [137][138]

a.text: 11 story missions; Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab are optional Billy jobs.

b.text: 13, counting those two as story.

disputes.call: 11; the two Billy jobs count toward The Lone Rider instead.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
In short: Finish Chapter 3 in Vice City (to The Cartel Heist); it opens most crime trophies.
1. Chapter 3 moves to Vice City and unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia: 26 missions to The Cartel Heist. [97][99][117]
2. Credit Check opens small banks and Payday Loans and gives the Dye Pack Jammer for marked bills. [18][20][55]
3. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs give the Snap Gun; Here, Kitty Kitty opens Tyrone's labs; Clonin' Keys gives the Key Cloner for Randy. [1][48][70]
4. Race Against Yago is time-limited: play it as soon as it appears. [25][41][61]
5. The trophy comes after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. [1][30]
6. Meet the Heders, early in the chapter, gives the Cut-off Tool: it cuts the locks on orange SCOOP containers, which hold cash and loot. [141][142]
7. Timed optional missions such as Race Against Yago show an hourglass icon on the map and expire if left too long. [68][134]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
In short: Finish Chapter 4, the longest, ending with Starting From Zero. Open the bank vaults while here.
1. Chapter 4 has 25 missions from Ocean Beach to Starting From Zero. [61][99][117]
2. Near its end, play the optional That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): it opens the 8 large bank vaults. [18][48][54]
3. The optional call This Is a Free Call From… (Lucia) is timed in this chapter; no trophy needs it. [31][118]
4. The trophy unlocks after Starting From Zero and cannot be missed. [1][30]
5. After VCIA Takedown the chapter winds down with Tie Up Loose Ends, Call Valentina Back, Sunset and Starting From Zero. [31][134]
6. Missing a timed optional mission such as the Free Call also costs nothing toward 100% completion. [31][134]

a.text: GameTrek's trophy page lists it as Chapter 5.

b.text: The other guides tie it to the end of Chapter 4.

disputes.call: Chapter 4, as the official description says.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
In short: Gold for the final mission, The End of the Road. Save just before it; free roam continues after.
1. Chapter 5 is the shortest: 7 missions from Bird in the Hand to The End of the Road. [34][97][99][117]
2. The game asks you to confirm before the finale, a run of missions leading to one of several endings. [68][103]
3. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it: it lets you see another ending. [67][68][105]
4. After the credits you return to just before the finale with progress kept, and the 100% checklist appears. [103][105][124]
5. The finale starts outside a law office where Jason and Lucia wait; you can walk away and keep playing until you choose to go in. [105]
6. The finale marker stays on the map after the credits, so you can play the finale again and possibly reach another ending. [103][105]
7. Nothing has to be cleared before the finale: side-story finales and bank vault jobs stay available after the credits. [54][67][103]

b.text: Finish the final mission.

disputes.call: The same moment: the final mission closes Chapter 5.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
In short: Breakfast Run, the 8th Chapter 2 mission (Lucia), just before Coffee Break.
1. Breakfast Run is the 8th mission of Chapter 2, played as Lucia. [31][99][117]
2. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
3. Coffee Break follows and reunites Jason and Lucia: the partner trophies open from then. [1][30][49]
4. Chapter 2 is Lucia-only for hours until this mission; afterwards Jason is playable again and each of them gets a personal vehicle. [101][143][144]
5. It ends with a 2-star wanted level; small off-road trails are the easiest way to lose the police. [143][144]
6. The mission is a robbery run: Hank's Waffles, a liquor store and a thrift store. Threaten the staff and grab the cash; each has a generous 1-minute timer. [143][144]
7. After Slam Dunk, wait for Jason's call (about half an in-game day, sooner if you do other main missions); the Starlet Motel icon then turns pink. [143][144]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
In short: The Cartel Heist, the 26th and last mission of Chapter 3.
1. The Cartel Heist closes Chapter 3 as its 26th mission. [97][99][117]
2. Its build-up runs through Sinfrontera National Bank, Security Expert and Hidden Charges. [97][99]
3. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
4. The heist runs from blowing cell towers and cracking the vault to defending a bus and a freeway escape; GTABase lists a $120,000 payout. [145]
5. Safe Word, earlier in the chapter, ends with safecracking practice you can repeat as often as you like at Raul's compound; it uses the heist's mechanics. [146][147]
6. It opens once Hidden Charges and the rest of Chapter 3 are done: wait for Raul to get in touch, then meet him at the planning room in Stockyard. [134][145]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
In short: Child's Play, the 17th mission of Chapter 4.
1. Child's Play is the 17th mission of Chapter 4. [97][99]
2. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
3. Nearby, the optional call This Is a Free Call From… is marked missable; no trophy needs it. [31][118]
4. The run-up (Adventures in Babysitting, Rafa's Kidnapping, Fresh Evidence) is Jason-only; Child's Play itself uses both leads. [134][148][149]
5. Child's Play is the rescue of Rafa from his kidnappers, a few missions after Jason's Rafa mission. [31][134][149]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
In short: Headliners, straight after Child's Play in Chapter 4.
1. Headliners is the 18th Chapter 4 mission in the Dexerto, GameRant and GTABase lists, straight after Child's Play.,dx,gr-story,gbm [97][99]
2. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
3. The Dimez's feud with rapper DWNPLY goes back to Chapter 3's Cooties, where Lucia trashes his car in their music video. [151][152]
4. In Headliners the Dimez perform at VYB and Jason and Lucia help run the launch party. [134][150]

a.text: Right after Child's Play, 18th in Chapter 4.

b.text: Later: after Fully Catered and Heist Plans in Place, just before VCIA Takedown.

disputes.call: Some main missions can be taken in a different order; either way it comes mid Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
In short: VCIA Takedown, late in Chapter 4 (not the free-roam jet theft).
1. VCIA Takedown is the 23rd Chapter 4 mission, after Fully Catered. [97][99]
2. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
3. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam jet theft at VCIA. [52][67]
4. From Making Gainz until VCIA Takedown, Jason and Lucia cannot be seen together, so the missions in between switch between Jason-only and Lucia-only. [118][158]
5. After VCIA Takedown only Sunset and Starting From Zero are left in Chapter 4. [1][61][81][97]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
In short: Operation Savage Glory, the 5th of 7 Chapter 5 missions.
1. Operation Savage Glory is the 5th of 7 missions in Chapter 5. [97][99]
2. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends and cannot be missed. [1][30]
3. Protective Custody and the finale follow: save before the finale. [67][97]
4. Before the finale the game asks you to confirm, and its marker stays on the map, so you can finish other tasks first. [61][103]
5. The four Chapter 5 missions before it are Bird in the Hand, Taking Liberties, VC Baby and Doggie Bag. [61][81][97][99]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
In short: Gold for 100%. The checklist shows after the story; earlier progress counts and nothing on it is missable.
1. The checklist appears only after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made earlier counts. [1][62][105][123]
2. It has 35 tasks; nothing on it is missable and all of it can be done in free roam. [3][33][77][123]
3. No slack on: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loans, 8 vaults, 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, 15 Bret decks, 33 underwater finds. [62][77][123]
4. Partial: 300/397 stunts, 70/80 challenges, 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 15/18 card sets, 15/18 meditations, 30/34 magazines, 100/125 flamingos, 90/100 hoops, 5/7 Kenton sets. [3][62][77][124]
5. Also: 100 optional tasks and $250,000 of marked bills fenced. [30][62][115]
6. Take every key valuable at a gang operation on the first visit: restocks are slow and partial. [33][113][123]
7. Only mini golf counts (King Gator Adventure Golf, Frontier Adventure Golf, Dino Golf Challenge); the two full-size golf courses do not. [3][33]
8. The 90 hoops must be different ones: scoring again at the same hoop does not count. Find them under Map > Exploration > Points of Interest. [3][33]
9. Also on the list: beat 5 of the 7 pool opponents, play 2 of the 3 mini golf courses, and start all 4 video games. [3][33][62][77][123]

b.text: 10 of the 13 race challenges.

disputes.call: 10 of 13: with only 13 challenges, 30 golds cannot be right.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
In short: Any 250 of 397 stunts; Under the Bridges are quickest. Go on to 300 for 100%.
1. 397 stunts count together: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. [1][9][30][60]
2. Under the Bridges are the fastest to pile up. [1][30]
3. Just doing a stunt counts; its optional challenge is not needed. [9][30]
4. Stunt Jumps by county: Vice-Dale 55, Kelly 29, Mariana 17, Lummox 16, Leonard 13. Track at Progress > Activities > Stunts. [9][60]
5. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going. [1][62][123]
6. Under the Bridges and Knife Flights are flown in an aircraft (Knife Flights tip the plane through gaps between Vice City towers); Base Jumps are parachute drops through checkpoints. [60]
7. In Progress > Activities > Stunts, highlight Stunt Jumps and press R3 for a county-by-county count. [9][163]
8. Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots lists every stunt you have found by name, done or not. [9][60][163]
9. On the map a found stunt shows purple and a finished one turns white; both stay marked. [9][163]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
In short: Try each of the nine activity types once; most happen along the way.
1. Nine types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one), an arcade game, a race or drone race, and a stunt. [1][30][60]
2. Progress > Activities shows which are still untried. [30][153]
3. Most come naturally on the way to Baited My Tackle, Fair Game, Stick Fiddler and Cunning Stunts. [1][30]
4. A free fishing rod waits on the jetty behind Jason's house in Key Lento. [156]
5. Golf here means mini golf, on any of three courses: King Gator Adventure Golf, Frontier Adventure Golf or Dino Golf Challenge. [33][153]
6. For basketball, each hoop has a ball beside it; one stands outside Jason's house. [33][153]
7. Pool is 8-ball on tables in bars, taverns and cafes; one game ticks it off. [33][153]
8. Activities use a dumbbell icon on the map; filter them under Map > Activities. [1][3][153]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
In short: Gold all 42 challenges at Griffin (18) and Rodgers Ranch (24). Rentals are enough.
1. 42 golds over two ranges: Griffin (6 courses × 3 medals) and Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn (6 × 4). [12][60][67]
2. Buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk; $10 rental guns are enough for every gold. [12][33]
3. At Griffin, speed beats bullseyes (one saves 1 s); slow time on the spinning Hook and Loop targets. [12][153][154]
4. Rodgers Ranch scores with a multiplier that misses reset; Cops & Robbers is sniper headshots throughout. [12][153][154]
5. Every finished challenge permanently raises Focus, which helps Gunslinger. [12][43][90]
6. Menu: Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges; some challenges unlock only after others. [3][60]
7. On Rodgers Ranch's Hunting Range, put about four body shots into each bear before its weak spot. [12][153]
8. Play Griffin's timed courses as Lucia: she runs faster and turns better than Jason. [12][153][154]
9. The range challenges do not show on the map until you have bought that range's waiver. [12][33][153]
10. Griffin is in northwest Vice City; Rodgers Ranch is in northeast Port Gellhorn. [12][153][154]

b.text: Two ranges hold all 42 golds, in 12 challenges between them.

disputes.call: Two ranges: the "12" counts challenges, not places to visit.

b.text: A bronze in each challenge.

disputes.call: Get the 42 golds; the trophy needs them anyway.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
In short: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; finish all 42 trials while there for 100%.
1. Top Fun Drones has 14 locations holding 42 races; one win per location is enough. [1][30][60][67]
2. Some locations charge an entry fee; find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones. [3][60][153]
3. The 100% checklist wants all 42 time trials. [30][58][62][123]
4. A drone race icon only appears once you are within about 100 m; Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones lists the ones you have found. [33][60][153]
5. Each location has three trials: beat par on the first two to open the third, which you only need to finish. [3][33][153]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
In short: Win 20 different races of 40; repeats do not count. 100% needs 30.
1. There are 40 unique races; win 20 different ones. A repeat win adds nothing. [13][30][60]
2. Many races let you hire a car; raise your car's Rating at Mod Shops (Touch Pad > Activities > Racing). [3][60][153]
3. Separate from races, 13 Race Challenges award medals; 100% wants 30 race wins and 10 challenge golds. [14][62][77]
4. Yago's strand starts with street races in Chapter 3; Race Against Yago is time-limited. [25][41]
5. The AI catches up when behind, so a lead is never safe until the finish line. [153]
6. The Thrillbilly Mud Club's 8 dirt and oval races open through Billy's optional Chapter 2 mission Thrillbillies. [13]
7. At Gellhorn Raceway (south of Port Gellhorn) do the introduction lap with Beau first; it opens the rest of the track's races. [13][162]
8. Race icons turn up in blue only within about 100 m; filter them with Map > Activities > Racing. [13][33][153]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
In short: After Feng Shui (Chapter 1) Cal texts you; win his fishing challenge west of Key Lento.
1. After Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1, Cal texts about a purple fishing icon west of Key Lento. [1][30][156][157]
2. His quest is Catch a Bigger Fish; it does not count for Strangers & Freaks. [21][156][157][158]
3. Cal wants a stoplight parrotfish heavier than 2 lb (about 0.9 kg), caught with a rod from a boat.,b-pp-fish,b-ol-fish,b-gfz-fish [60]
4. The fishing in Gone Fishing and Recalibration is scripted story, not this challenge. [26][29][158]
5. Fishing also counts for Master of None and trains Focus. [30][43][90]
6. The starter Small Saltwater Lure is enough; release parrotfish under 2 lb and keep casting inside the circle. [155][156][157]
7. Jason's boat is gone after Chapter 1: take a fishing boat from the docks by The Rusty Anchor and drop anchor from the vehicle menu. [155][157]
8. His spot is a purple circle out on the water in Gambit Bay, Mariana County. [155][156][157]

b.text: Over 2 kg.

disputes.call: 2 lb, as three guides say; a fish over 2 kg would satisfy both.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
In short: Clear every level of one of the four video games; three are on the TV at home.
1. Four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home JoySystem, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets. [1][15][30]
2. Clear all levels of any one game; its extra challenges are not needed. [1][30][67]
3. The home console is off during Chapter 2 and back in Chapter 3; Feng Shui has you play two games. [15][159][160][161]
4. One Bang For Your Buck cabinet stands outside Bargain World in Port Gellhorn. [15][159][160]
5. 100% wants all four played; starting and quitting a game counts. [15][58][62]
6. Other Bang For Your Buck cabinets: Xero Food Mart (south Kelly County), Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds (Downtown Vice City) and Electric Boulevard in Stockyard. [160]
7. Pick the game that suits you: Tenebrae Lux is a puzzle game, Time Jackers Rewind a timed top-down shooter, Street Trash III a top-down zombie shooter. [159][161]
8. The home console sits on the coffee table in front of the TV in Jason's house; interact with it to pick a game. [15][159][160]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
In short: Lucia-only: Andy's five quests from Chapter 3 in Belville, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
1. In Chapter 3 Andy calls and texts Lucia her new address in Belville; the strand is Lucia-only. [1][67][70]
2. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (three parts), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. [1][32]
3. Puff Puff Pass starts when Cecilia calls Lucia to the Paper Boys warehouse; it pays $10,000 and refunds the $5,000 fee. [39][167]
4. The trophy pops on Puff Puff Pass; the strand stays open after the story. [1][39]
5. Andy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. [32][48][70][122]
6. Read the Label: take the stolen Cellerica van from north Vice City to the Belville warehouse; Cecilia pays $1,800. [32][166]
7. The later quests take a while to trigger: keep playing as Lucia until Andy or Cecilia gets in touch. [39][165][166][167]
8. Have $5,000 ready: the Cellerica fee is sent to Andy through the BuckMe app, from anywhere. [39][165]
9. Climbing the Cellerichain is three deliveries for Andy: to Waning Sands, a market stall in north Vice City, then a house in Ambrosia. [32][70][164]
10. Andy's call comes after Lucia's Mami Knows Best and Car Service missions; her new house is in Belville, Leonard County. [164]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
In short: Kenton's treasure dives: recover all 7 shipwreck sets. Starts with Island Dreams in Chapter 1.
1. Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) starts at his beach shop in Key Lento after Hey Arnold!; it pays $400. [11][85]
2. Kenton then lends his boat, scuba gear and a metal detector; his shop is a green KR icon, dives are purple chests. [30][74][102]
3. Clear all 7 shipwreck sets; the detector beeps faster, then steady, near treasure. [1][70][74][85]
4. Kenton leaves after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapters 2-3; calling Brian in Chapter 2 may speed this. [1][50][74]
5. Not missable and open after the story. Track at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees; 100% wants 5 of 7. [3][73][74]
6. Finishing his strand (Maritime Disputes) lets you take the Rugger Fortune boat in place of Kenton's Huntress. [66]
7. The wrecks lie in the water around Key Lento (south and east of it); the first, Nuestra Señora del Ocio, is found during Island Dreams itself. [66][74]
8. After each set, bring the finds back to Kenton to sell; he then calls and marks the next wreck. A finished set pays a large bonus. [50][66][74]
9. Pick the metal detector from the bottom-right slot of the weapon wheel and aim with L2; sweep the pink search zone until its light turns from red to green, then take the chest. [11][74][170]

b.text: A final mission, Maritime Disputes.

disputes.call: Do all 7 sets; if it has not popped, look for Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
In short: Billy's five jobs from the Thrillbilly Mud Club (after Coffee Break); Hometown Heroes awards it.
1. After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), Billy is marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. [1][120]
2. Five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. [1][32][75]
3. Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab: chase an armored truck on a dirt bike, blow its rear door, grab a bag. [27][171]
4. Hometown Heroes comes by text a few days after The Impaler, uses both leads and pays $10,000. [24][40]
5. Billy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. [24][32][40][122]
6. The Impaler: reply to Wyman's text, hop the Ambrosia impound fence, take the only black-and-white cruiser (3 stars) and lose the police in the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia. [174][177]
7. Mall Rats can take a long while to arrive (mid Chapter 3) and is solo only: meet Billy in Ocean Beach, ride into the mall, rob the jewelers' safe and escape. Pays $12,000. [173][176]
8. Thrillbillies: buy outfits at the club shop, rent a bike at Roostere's Rentals (the Sanchez is faster) and race 13 riders. You need not win, just avoid last; 1st pays $2,500. [172][175]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
In short: Finish 8 stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; play Race Against Yago at once.
1. Confirmed to count: Kirk (3 quests, Chapter 1), Kyle (3, Chapter 2), Yago (Chapter 3) and Pilot Pete (5, Chapter 4, Jason). [1][21][119][120]
2. Not counted: Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Yasmani, Moses, Shirley and Eddie Acosta. [21][70][119][122]
3. The game does not say which strands count: check the trophy's progress before and after each last quest. [21][48]
4. Follow-ups arrive by call or text after in-game days or a chapter change; Kirk's strand ends in Chapter 2. [21][57]
5. Race Against Yago appears days after Bumper to Bumper in Salton: choose the Freeway Run. [25][41]
6. Unfinished strands that are not timed stay open after the story. [21][120]
7. Stranger jobs show as Optional Missions in the map list or as purple markers, but some stay hidden and unmarked, so an empty map does not mean you have found them all. [21][121]
8. Two of Yago's races, Bumper to Bumper and Brother to Brother, are Jason-only: switch to Jason if they will not start. [21][119]
9. Kirk's first and last quests are night-only, and the last one, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics, can only be played as Lucia. [21][119]

missable.why: Yago's strand counts, and Race Against Yago has a limited-time hourglass. Whether missing it ends the strand is unconfirmed.
missable.ponr: Race Against Yago's timer in Chapter 3 (length not stated).
missable.before: Save when it appears and race at once.

a.text: Bret, Randy and Kenton do not count either.

b.text: Four more count but are unnamed; Bret, Randy and Dunk unstated.

disputes.call: Unresolved: finish every stranger and watch the counter.

unconfirmed: Which four strands make up the rest of the 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
In short: Deliver Randy's Wish List cars, opened by the Key Cloner in Chapter 3.
1. Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS gives the Key Cloner and opens Randy's Wish List. [1][70]
2. The first car, the Zorrusso, is delivered in the story (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). [1][97][99]
3. Track it at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; Randy is the green RK icon in west Vice City. Scan a car with WAiNK to check it is wanted. [1][64]
4. Cleaner cars pay more; many spawn near the Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels. Infernus, Mamba GT and Ascot Paragon have trackers. [1][64]
5. Delivering the Mamba GT lets Pay 'n' Spray handle advanced trackers. The list is needed for 100%. [42][93]
6. Talking to Randy at Leonida Auto World can give hints on where a wanted car is found. [64]
7. Cars with advanced trackers send your location to the police unless you drive fast, so keep your speed up all the way to Randy. [47][64]
8. Undamaged Wish List cars pay around $35,000 or more each, the quickest route to the 100% list's $200,000 fencing goal. [3][33]

b.text: 22 cars; the Mamba GT is added by the extra job ¡Dale Mamba!.

disputes.call: Deliver every car Map > Robberies still lists.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
In short: Jason-only: destroy Tyrone's Kitty Litter labs from Chapter 3, then finish Spin On This.
1. After Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), labs show as purple markers in Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter); Jason only. [1][37][70]
2. Each lab destroyed pays $2,000 or $2,500 by BuckMe. [23][37]
3. Once enough are gone, Spin On This starts at a diner outside Grayson, Lummox County; it pays $10,000. [22][36]
4. In it: take the motel clerk's key, clear the lab behind the green door, charge two vats, chase down Rocky. [22][36]
5. Labs are not missable and can be finished after the story. [23][37]
6. Wear body armor and bring a long gun before reaching the diner. In the pipe, just run (shooting Rocky does nothing); outside, aim for his head. [22][36]
7. Read the papers, receipts and cards inside labs: Spin On This unlocks after enough labs are destroyed and enough information is gathered. Burnt labs are the only sign one is done. [23][37]
8. To destroy a lab, shoot its propane tanks or gas cans or throw a Molotov through the door. Some need the Snap Gun or a forced door; one keypad code is on a nearby billboard. [23][37]
9. Find each lab inside its purple search zone by the building leaking pink gas. Tyrone and Dook give more spots if asked, and a cook you question may point to another lab. [23][37]

b.text: 14 (its own list adds up to 13).

disputes.call: 13 can be located; clear them all.

unconfirmed: How many labs trigger Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
In short: 18 meditations at 10 spots. Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony session may count and is gone after Chapter 1: do it.
1. The morning after Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house (Key Lento): follow her to the balcony, look at her (L2), choose Accept. [2][114][116]
2. That session adds 1 to the counter but is not a marked spot, and it is gone once Chapter 2 starts. [2][114][116]
3. The 18 add up as 8 shared spots twice each (Jason and Lucia), plus Lucia's balcony session and Ascent Mountain once each. [2][168]
4. Most spots count once as Jason and once as Lucia, so both must be playable (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). [2][30][123]
5. Call your partner before setting off so both meditate at each spot in one trip instead of visiting every spot twice. [33][58]
6. Spots: Smooth Sand (off west Capri), Swamp (Buckskin Swamp), Worn Stone (Camp Moonflower), Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall, Seaside. [2][168]
7. Route by county: Kelly has Swamp, Worn Stone and Red Rocks (Manifest Canyon); Lummox has Water Wheel (paper mill), Jutting Cliff and Waterfall (NW of Tallaloko). [2][168]
8. Seaside is a rocky outcrop on the beach east of Waning Sands (Leonard County); Smooth Sand is a sandbar off Capri's west coast (Mariana County). [2][168]
9. The last, Ascent Mountain on the Mount Kalaga summit, appears only once all others are done. [2][168]
10. Ascent Mountain counts once and needs Jason and Lucia together, so it waits until joint free roam opens after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). [2][30][50][73]
11. Spots show a purple icon only once you are close; found ones appear with the map's Exploration filter Meditate Around Leonida. [2][60][67]
12. Let the full animation play or it will not count. Track at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. [2][60]
13. 100% needs only 15 of 18, but the trophy needs every one. [2][116][123]
14. Meditating also trains Focus, so the tour doubles as Focus practice. [78][90][169]

missable.why: The balcony session cannot be redone, and no source confirms all 18 are reachable without it.

a.text: Yes: skip it and the trophy is lost.

b.text: Unconfirmed; PowerPyx did it and earned the trophy.

disputes.call: Treat it as required: it takes two minutes.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
In short: Jason-only: Bret's hunting strand from Chapter 2; the trophy animal is not confirmed yet.
1. Some time after Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason (not Lucia); Veteran Hunted starts in Lummox County near Mount Kalaga. [1][3][57][70]
2. It gives the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; Ammu-Nation weapon lockers can replace it. [1][33]
3. Bret's Hunting Decks follow: 15 Target Decks, sent one after another, all needed for 100%. [3][38][65][70]
4. Only Pristine or Good carcasses are accepted: use a clean head or heart shot. [3][65][67]
5. First decks: whitetail buck and doe; then a white tom turkey, a spotted skunk (night) and a wild boar. [65]
6. PowerPyx expects the trophy to pop naturally while working through the decks. [1]
7. Bret texts each new deck with hints such as whether the animal is out at night; use a scope and shoot from range, since some animals flee if you get close. [65]
8. Bret picks up big kills such as boars himself; smaller animals go in the bed of a pickup truck, as with the first deer. [65][178]
9. Track the decks at Map > Activities > Target Deck, or at Progress > Contacts > Bret Vogel. [1][3][33]
10. Hold L3 and R3 to use Focus: it shows the animal's scent trail and its vital spots, so you can line up a clean head or heart shot. [65][178]
unconfirmed: Which of Bret's animals awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
In short: Any 3 of 18 card sets; the cheapest three total 54 cards. Two Chapter 2 cards are lost later.
1. 18 sets, 480 cards, from 12 to 36 cards a set.,pp-cards,gt-coll,gg-coll,fxc [4][33][50]
2. Cheapest three: Backyard Wrestling (12), Delights Dancers (18) and any 24-card set, 54 cards in all. [4][50][95]
3. Before Chapter 2 ends, take Vicki (Starlet Motel office bathroom) and Victor Maravilla (motel kitchen fridge). [5][6][95]
4. Cards are pick-ups only (surfaces, walls, yellow phone boxes, toolboxes); they cannot be bought. [4][95]
5. Selling a card at a Pawn Shop keeps it in your set; Bronze, Silver and Gold variants count separately. [4][60][95]
6. 100% needs 15 of 18 sets (Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards). [3][33][62]
7. Choose by what you already hold: a bigger set you have mostly finished can need fewer pickups than a fresh small one. [50]
8. Pawn Shops pay from about $20 to over $1,000 a card depending on rarity. [4][95]
9. Some cards lie in more than one place; a second copy adds nothing to the set, but it can still be sold. [4][33][73][95]

missable.why: Two Starlet Motel cards are lost after Chapter 2. That costs the Delights Dancers and Los Santos Corkers sets, not the trophy.
missable.before: pick up both motel cards in Port Gellhorn.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
In short: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.
1. Open the WAiNK app (D-pad up, then R1); nearby spots vibrate and show a notice. [1][7][73]
2. Any 100 count from Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher Tags. [1][8][50][63][73]
3. No Flusher Tags are painted ground markings; every scan spot is outdoors. [7][50]
4. AHOL Street Art, 1010 Murals and Magazine Tattoos are scanned too but do not count. [7][73]
5. Track at Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations; 100 is also the 100% target. [3][7][60]
6. Big sights worth a scan include the Imperial Spanish Ruins, the Gellhorn Funfair Ferris wheel, Kalaga Lookout and St Lucia Lighthouse. [73]
7. Two of the five WAiNK groups start locked with no total; a group shows up once you scan its first entry. [50][125]
8. Vehicle scans are a separate counter: scanning cars, boats or aircraft never adds to the 100 locations. [3][33][50]

a.text: 112 in four groups (23 No Flusher Tags).

b.text: Five sets, one still unknown; 89 visible at first.

disputes.call: At least 112 exist, so 100 is reachable.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
In short: 50 of the 80 challenges; check late, many finish on their own. 100% needs 70.
1. 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10: Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival, Vehicle. [17][53]
2. Progress > Challenges lists them; many finish naturally, so check late. [1][30][60]
3. 70 are needed for 100%: skip the hardest, such as Train Landing, Train Jump or Helipad Flyovers. [53][58][123]
4. The Combat challenge Headshots asks for 4 headshot kills in one use of Combat Focus.,pp-chal,gg-chal [17][53]
5. Several overlap with other trophy work: scan 4 WAiNK spots, find 3 cards in each county, study 20 animal species. [17][53]
6. Read the fine print first: many must be done in one day, without dying or arrest, or without taking damage, and fail if you break that. [17][53]
7. Start the slow Fitness ones early: Strength Regime and Cardio Regime need level 4 on both Jason and Lucia for 5 days in a row. [17][53]
8. All 80 are open from the start and can be done in any order. [17][33][53]

b.text: Shooting-range and racing challenges.

disputes.call: General: two guides list all 8 groups.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
In short: With your partner, reach 4 stars and leave the red heat zone; a vault job does it too.
1. After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold right on the D-pad, then triangle). [1][30]
2. Reach 4 stars; a bank vault robbery gives 4 at once. [1][30][67]
3. Leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. [1][67]
4. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) is the suggested escape. [1][30][106]
5. Break line of sight, hide in bushes or a parked car, spare the cops; police know you as a pair, so split or change outfit. [46][100]
6. Do not turn back: being spotted or committing a crime inside the heat area brings the wanted level straight back. [46][100]
7. If police know your car, switch it or respray it, and keep clear of CCTV cameras while you shake the heat. [46][71][100]
8. Shooting at a chasing helicopter makes it back off; a fast sports motorbike also helps you outrun four stars. [1][46]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
In short: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your stars; the north Vice City jewelers work.
1. Possible after Coffee Break; bring your partner. [1][48]
2. Keep the stars between shops: if they fade and only the red heat zone is left, the chain breaks. [1][67]
3. Route: the three close jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3). [1][30]
4. Bring armor and Sticky Bombs for back-room safes; threaten staff and hold L2 to get registers opened. [1][109]
5. It can lag about 30 seconds; if nothing pops, rob a fourth. [1][30][67]
6. Dying or getting busted costs the cash and stash bags you carry, so bank the takings at an ATM once the chain is done. [45][54]
7. The same run can also clear the Stick Ups challenge: rob 3 stores in one day without dying or being arrested. [17][53][182]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
In short: Scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK beside a busy road; 100% needs 200 of 277.
1. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK discovers it; no need to drive it. A busy road is fastest. [1][30]
2. Boats and aircraft count; Standout Vehicles do not. [33][115]
3. Cars delivered to Moses or Randy count too. Track at Progress > Vehicles. [1][60][123]
4. Go on to 200 of 277 base models for 100%. [3][33][104]
5. A scan also shows the car's security, such as alarm and tracker, which helps if you plan to steal it. [47][187]
6. Traffic differs by region: supercars near the Ocean Beach hotels, vans and trucks in Port Gellhorn, basic cars in Key Lento. [3][33]
7. Hold Up on the D-pad to bring out WAiNK, then hold R1 to scan the vehicle. [3][47]

b.text: Scan with WAiNK.

disputes.call: Scan everything: it works either way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
In short: In one Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) drop 5 gang members; train Focus first.
1. Combat Focus unlocks in Chapter 1's Down to Earth: aim, then press L3 + R3. [43][67][88]
2. Use gang members at an Illegal Operation; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to count. [1][30][67]
3. An assault rifle helps; Adrenaline or food with the Focus icon makes it last longer. [1][67][90]
4. Ranges, golf putting, pool, fishing and meditation permanently extend the bar. [43][78][90]
5. Refill it with coffee or tea, sleep or a shower at a safehouse. [12][43]
6. A Focus boost from food or drink lasts until you are wasted or end the session, so eat just before the attempt. [43][90]
7. Pair it with the Headshots challenge: 4 headshot kills in one Combat Focus also counts toward the 50 challenges. [17][53][182]
8. In Combat Focus, red spots on an enemy are lethal and yellow spots (arms, legs) incapacitate; headshots drop targets fastest. [43][188]
9. Incapacitating an enemy counts the same as a kill, but each Combat Focus lasts only a few seconds. [1][188]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
In short: Steal a jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge (E3/E4), take off and fly about 1 km away.
1. Only a large passenger jet docked at a departure boarding bridge works; planes on the airfield do not. [1][30][52]
2. Gates E3 and E4 are easiest. [1][30][69]
3. A Brute Ripley airport tug gets you to the plane; board with the Pilot plane prompt. [52]
4. Take off and fly about 1 km (0.6 mi) away. [1][30][69]
5. Stealing a plane no longer means instant five stars, but expect police. [110][183]
6. You will almost surely be wanted before takeoff, with police jets following, so save first and keep moving. [67][184]
7. The engines take a while to start, so you cannot roll away the moment you sit down. [184]
8. Drive through the airfield fence, enter by the door at the stairs beside the boarding bridge, go up to the cockpit and reverse the jet out toward the runway. [1][30][48]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
In short: Take a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and fight from it; save first.
1. Tanks sit at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the west end of the Keys (Mariana County). [1][30][69][106]
2. Get in by the gate, the stunt jump near the southeast entrance, or by parachute. [1][69][106]
3. Save first: the wanted level climbs to 5, then 6 stars within minutes. [67][69][106][183]
4. Escape on a fast bike via the Ambrosia train tunnel; military vehicles cannot be kept. [69][106]
5. Park a car in front of the tank as cover while you climb in; the cannon fires with R1. [69]
6. Six stars are close to impossible to lose, so ditch the slow tank for something faster early. [69][183]
7. Expect about 3 stars the moment you climb into a tank, before the military response builds. [69][181]

a.text: As soon as you take the tank, or a few seconds after you get in.

b.text: Only after you fight from inside it.

disputes.call: Shoot from the tank until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
In short: With the Snap Gun (Yasmani, Chapter 3), rob a jewelry store unseen: back door, safe code, alarm, footage.
1. Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun. [1][30][48]
2. Pick the back door with it; kicking the door trips the alarm. [1][30][67]
3. Read the safe code on the back-room note, loot the safe, then disable the alarm and the footage. [1][30]
4. Shooting cameras does not erase the cloud CCTV. [45][54]
5. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is suggested. [1][30][48]
6. Donovan Banks & Co. also has a Snap Gun back door, with alarm and footage controls in its back office; Casa de Empeño has no such door. [179]
7. At Richardson, the panel right of the central-room door disarms security, the box under the security screen wipes footage, and the safe is in the northeast corner. [179]
8. Jewelers show on the map as green Smash 'n' Grab icons (Map > Robberies); hovering one shows its estimated take. [45][180]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
In short: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults (opened in Chapter 4) and escape each time.
1. The optional That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), late in Chapter 4, opens the 8 large vaults. [18][54][67]
2. Tail a security van to its bank: the vault opens briefly when the guard brings a briefcase in. [18][54]
3. Bring your partner. A vault gives 4 stars at once: flee on a fast motorbike, then swap vehicles. [18][54][67]
4. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 after his Payday Loans jobs. [1][54]
5. Each vault pays up to about $205,000; your getaway vehicle caps how much you carry. [18][54]
6. 100% wants all 8; they stay open after the story. [1][54][58][67]
7. Lombank Downtown and one Lombank in Ocean Beach pay most ($135k-$205k); four of the eight vaults are in Ocean Beach. [18]
8. The 14 small banks (from Credit Check, Chapter 3) have only a drawer and safe; this trophy needs the 8 large vaults. [18][33]
9. One person cannot carry a whole vault: hand a bag to your partner (hold Right on the D-pad) or stow it in the trunk; a crash can knock it loose. [3][30][54]
10. Track vaults with Map > Robberies > Bank Jobs: bright green means done, dark green not yet; hovering shows what is left. [18][33]

b.text: Silver.

disputes.call: Silver, as the official list says.
About $200,000; it is a ceiling, not a promise.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
In short: Rob an armored truck and leave the red heat zone; a bank vault job counts too.
1. A large bank vault robbery counts. [1][30]
2. Earlier route: box in an armored truck by a bank and sticky-bomb its rear doors. [1][30]
3. Leave the red heat zone (or reach a Pay 'n' Spray) to count as escaped. [30][67]
4. Billy's Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab also blows open a truck; its walkthrough does not say it awards this. [27][171]
5. For the getaway, the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) slows police and hides you from helicopters. [1][48]
6. Sticky Bombs for the truck doors are in the back of Yasmani's shop once his jobs are done. [1]
7. PowerPyx says it unlocks automatically in the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). [1]
unconfirmed: Whether the truck in Billy's mission counts.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
In short: Clear the fog from the whole map; a crop duster does it in about 4-5 hours.
1. Possible from Chapter 1, once free roam opens after Gone Fishing. [10][86]
2. Fog clears by map segment: dipping into a segment clears it. A visible outline is not the same as discovered. [10][51]
3. Fly the double-decker crop duster (Bottcher Duster); jets carry trackers and burn fuel fast. [10][86]
4. Planes wait at airstrips near Key Lento, in Mariana County and central Kelly County; land when fuel turns yellow. [10][86]
5. Allow 4-5 hours with refuels; save by hand, autosaves are rare. [10][86]
6. Airboats help in the Grassrivers marsh. [51]
7. A military jet is faster but brings 5 stars and pursuing fighter jets, so stick with the duster. [69][185]
8. The fuel gauge sits above the minimap (enable it in UI settings, Down on the D-pad shows it); running dry crashes the plane, but a fresh one respawns at the strip. [10][86][185]
9. If no plane has spawned at an airstrip, try the next one; Paradise Taxi from your phone contacts gets you to the southern strips fast. [10][86]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
In short: Rob one Illegal Operation of each of the 9 gangs (39 in all); take every key valuable.
1. Nine gangs run 39 Illegal Operations (yellow masked icons). [19][30][59][79]
2. Kingfishers 3, Kolts & Associates 5, M7 2, La Polilla Negra 2, Final Chapter 4, San4San 5, PTT Youngin$ 2, Guardia Brothers 3, Other Criminals 13. [19][59]
3. A spot counts only once every key valuable (safe plus previewed items) is taken. [19][59]
4. Safe codes are random: find the note on site or search a knocked-out guard. [54][59]
5. Progress > Gangs shows each gang; the story marks 19 of the 39. [1][59][123]
6. All 39 are needed for 100%; done spots restock slowly and partly. [1][33][113]
7. Police answer hideouts more slowly than stores; a suppressed weapon keeps it quiet, while long gunfights draw patrols. [59]
8. The Ultimate Edition's bonus PTT Youngin$ site does not count toward the 39. [19][59]
9. A site stays hidden until you walk into its area (the map just says Robbery Opportunity); found ones list under Map > Robberies > Illegal Operations. [19][59]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
In short: PowerPyx: an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Ocean Beach, drunk by the bar.
1. Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and drink it standing by the bar. [1]
2. It is one of 122 bars (blue drink icons), listed with the Ocean Beach bars in Vice-Dale County. [16]
3. Another guide got it with any cocktail from the rooftop bar, drunk at the beach-side railing; try there if standing by the bar fails. [186]
4. The Ocean View has a poolside bar and a rooftop bar; a door behind the poolside bar leads to a lift up to the roof. [16][186]

a.text: Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.

b.text: No confirmed method yet.

disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's method; only one site confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
In short: PowerPyx: with the Key Cloner, take the blue Banshee and drive it out of the south Vice City showroom window.
1. Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 first. [1][70]
2. Take the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City; only that car counts. [1]
3. Drive it out through the showroom window; it pops a moment later. [1][126]
4. A key-cloned car needs no separate hotwiring, and Shacknews says cloning keeps the car alarm from going off. [203][205]
5. To use it, stand at the driver's door, pick Clone Key and hold the stick in the right spot until the bar fills; the car then opens and starts. [204][205]
6. Randy gives you the Key Cloner in the main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, around mid Chapter 3; it installs on the phone for both leads. [1][203][204][205]

a.text: The blue Banshee, out through the window.

b.text: No confirmed method yet.

disputes.call: Try it; two sites describe the window escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
In short: Rob all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn) and lose the police. Not missable.
1. The optional Lucia job Hit Kingpin Bowling (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2) marks this Kolts & Associates operation. [1][19][35]
2. Take the luxury watch (southeast room), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (pool table) and the safe in the small northeast office. [1][35]
3. Blow the safe with a Sticky Bomb; stock armor and Zombix and bring your partner. [1][35][67]
4. Lose the 2-star wanted level; it pops shortly after. [1][35]
5. Not missable: the alley respawns in Chapter 3 and items taken earlier still count. [1][30][35]
6. Find gang operations on the map under Robberies > Illegal Operations; Progress > Gangs shows your counts. [19]
7. The watch is a collectible and the Moreland 850 is a unique shotgun; your cash reward depends on how much loot you take and fence. [35][190]
8. Kingpin Bowling is the Kolts & Associates entry among 39 gang operations, all needed for 100%, and it also covers that gang for Pest Control. [19][35]

b.text: Rob all three key valuables and escape.

disputes.call: Rob it: four guides agree.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
In short: Max Strength for Jason and Lucia: train at a gym together after Coffee Break.
1. After Coffee Break, max the Strength stat for both leads (pause menu). [1][30][58]
2. Buy a gym membership once at the front desk; it covers both. [1][89]
3. Call your partner and train together: both train at once. [1][30][67]
4. Jason's Key Lento safehouse has a back-deck gym; after the story you can train at home. [30][89]
5. Strength grows with pull-ups and weights plus protein and rest; missed workouts lose progress. [78][169]
6. Check Strength for each lead in the phone's Fitness app or under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia. [1][30][192]
7. Always finish the whole workout; partial sessions do not give the full gain and PowerPyx says unfinished gains are lost. [78][169][192]
8. Train when rested and fed: a tired or hungry lead gets less out of each workout. [78][89][169]

b.text: A story trophy with no trigger.

disputes.call: Train Strength: three guides agree.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
In short: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; it fills in normal play. Irredeemable is permanent.
1. Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to see each counted action. [1][30]
2. Robberies and fights count, so it fills during normal play. [1][67]
3. Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable; Irredeemable cannot be undone. [1][30][108]
4. Your profile changes Focus gains: takedowns for Professional/Hardened, headshots for Violent/Psycho. [78][193][199][200]
5. Criminal Profile and relationship status do not affect 100%. [114]
6. PowerPyx says running over civilians and cops speeds it up, but killing civilians and police pushes your profile toward Psycho. [1][193][200]
7. At Psycho and above you can no longer surrender to the police. [193][199][200]
8. Jason and Lucia each have their own profile; view both in the Jason & Lucia menu (Touch Pad) or hold D-pad Right for a quick look. [193][199][200]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
In short: Unconfirmed. Leads only: a repeat of the Prologue Payday Loans robbery, or normal play.
1. No source has confirmed how this unlocks. [1][30][58][67]
2. PowerPyx's lead: the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, robbed again a certain way; its Payday Loans guide does not mention it. [1][20]
3. Output Lag says it may pop during normal play. [67]
4. Gamer Guides shows its unlock condition only as "Save Mark obtained". [127]
5. Of Zen and Computing files it with the story trophies that unlock during the campaign; no method is given. [126]
6. To test the Payday Loans lead: the Little Cuba store is job #4 of 7, and Payday Loans jobs only open after Credit Check in Chapter 3. [20]

missable.why: Its trigger is unknown, so no source can promise it stays open; Of Zen and Computing counts such vague trophies as the most at risk.
missable.ponr: none known; keep a manual save before one-off missions.

a.text: Rob the Prologue's Payday Loans again.

b.text: Succeed on a second attempt.

disputes.call: Unconfirmed: we will not invent a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
In short: UFO event near the Starlet Motel (Kelly County) after 2 AM, alone: help the woman, fetch her car.
1. Go alone after 2 AM to the woods by the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. [1][84][98]
2. Look for a parked car with blinking lights and open doors; if absent, leave and return. [1][84][98]
3. Follow the trail toward the white beam; the UFO drops a woman. [1][84][98]
4. Help her, then fetch her car: you are abducted on the way and wake days later to a call. [84][98]
5. Beebom says Chapter 2 must be reached; GameRant calls it part one of a three-part secret. [84][98]
6. When you reach the woman, press Triangle to help her, then pick a dialogue option. [84]
7. You lose three in-game days; your partner phones asking where you went, and GameRant says it does not hurt your relationship. [84][98]

a.text: The road northwest of the Starlet Motel.

b.text: A forest east of Port Gellhorn, near the motel.

disputes.call: Search around the Starlet Motel at 2 AM.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
In short: PowerPyx: on any bike, kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds in a crowd.
1. On any bike, kick pedestrians with Square: 10 within 60 seconds. [1]
2. Crowded Vice City or Ocean Beach streets work best. [1]
3. The kick is Square on PS5 (X on Xbox), on bicycles as well as on motorbikes and scooters. [201][202]

b.text: Still being confirmed.

disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's method; one site confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
In short: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences; needs the Dye Pack Jammer (Chapter 3).
1. Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), Chapter 3, gives the Dye Pack Jammer needed to launder. [1][20][55][123]
2. Marked bills come from banks and Payday Loans; take them to a fence. [1][55][109]
3. Yasmani pays the most; bills left at one of your garages can be collected by him. [30][54][55]
4. The total adds up over trips; one vault can pay up to $205,000. [1][18][55]
5. Death or arrest loses the bag; each lead carries at most $20,000 cash. [54][109]
6. $250,000 laundered is also a 100% line. [33][62]
7. Vault robberies stay repeatable after the story, the quickest way to top up the laundered total. [54][196]
8. Yasmani opens up through his Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; his $10,000 security-van tips need two Payday Loans robberies done first. [18][54][55]
9. Big vaults open after the optional Chapter 4 job That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe); robbing one gives an instant 4-star wanted level. [1][18][54][55]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
In short: Spend $100,000 across shops; guns, car mods and tattoos add up fastest.
1. All shop spending adds up; guns, car mods and tattoos are fastest. [1][30]
2. Shops: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing, 17 shoe, 18 salon, 11 tattoo, 15 electronics. [1]
3. Shops are listed under Touch Pad > Style. [60][197][198]
4. For spending money, Randy's Wish List supercars (from Chapter 3) can pay over $30,000 each in top condition. [196][205]
5. Some shops are Ultimate Edition only: PowerPyx marks Stock 305 and Electric Fang Tattoo exclusive, and pre-launch reports named three more (a salon and two mod shops). [197][198][206][207]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
In short: Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app (from Daily Driver, Chapter 2), about $160,000.
1. Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), Chapter 2, opens the Vice City Real Estate app. [1][30][67]
2. Buy the 8 garages for sale, about $160,000 in total; each adds a parking spot. [1][30][60][67]
3. Prices: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000 up to Atlantic Court $40,000. [60][191]
4. Story garages (like Valentina's on Ocean Beach) and pre-order bonus garages do not count. [1][30][56][91]
5. Safehouses and other property cannot be bought. [45][208]
6. The extra parking gives the free spaces On the Spot needs, so buy garages before registering cars. [1][30][48]
7. PowerPyx counts 16 garage spots once all 8 are bought (half of them from story garages), or 18 vehicle slots with your two personal cars. [191]
8. Raise the phone with Up and buy every garage inside the Vice City Real Estate app. [60][191]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
In short: Register 10 vehicles via Scooter Bros: Moses' garage first, any Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3.
1. The Scooter Bros app comes with Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), Chapter 2. [1][56][67]
2. Each registration needs a free garage space (see Little Boxes) and costs more for pricier cars. [1][56][60][67]
3. Early on, Moses' Port Gellhorn garage takes only tracker-free cars: Respray, then Register. [1][30]
4. From Chapter 3, cars with Standard trackers register at any Pay 'n' Spray. [1][56][67][93]
5. Tracked cars cannot be modded until registered; storing a car does not register it. [47][56]
6. Moses' registration screen shows how many owned vehicle slots you have. [56]
7. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep registration fees low. [1][30][48]
8. Registered cars can be called to you through Scooter Bros (phone, green car icon) for a small fee. [56][60][194]
9. Scan a car with the Waink app (hold Up) before taking it to Moses: it shows any tracker and the registration cost. [56][195][205]

a.text: A Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop.

b.text: Moses first; Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3.

disputes.call: Start with Moses, then Pay 'n' Spray.
